name: cotton-swab
description: A cotton swab with compact oval tips and a long exposed shaft.
useCase: Identify cotton swabs or small cosmetic application tools.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies a product or a specific grooming task.

16.reason: Compact tips leave a long visible shaft while their small interiors stay open.

24.reason: Symmetric oval tips share the diagonal shaft and leave clear interiors at both ends.
